description: This file defines the LeaveApplicationService class, which manages leave application processes within the HRM system, including applying for leave, validation, saving requests, handling leave statuses based on holidays or weekends, and interacting with workflow states and event dispatching.

classes.name: LeaveApplicationService
classes.description: Service class responsible for handling leave applications, including creating, validating, saving leave requests, and managing workflow states and events for leave administration.

methods.name: applyLeave
methods.description: Creates a new leave application after validation checks, throwing exceptions if validation fails.

methods.name: saveLeaveRequest
methods.description: Saves the leave request, handles leave entitlements, comments, and dispatches leave application events.

methods.name: getLeaveRequestStatus
methods.description: Determines the leave request status based on whether the leave date falls on a weekend or holiday, or defaults to pending approval.

methods.name: allowToExceedLeaveBalance
methods.description: Indicates if employees are allowed to exceed their leave balance (default: false).

methods.name: getWorkflowItemForApplyAction
methods.description: Retrieves the workflow state machine item associated with the 'APPLY' leave action.
